topics.topic: Aiki da Rabe-rabensa: Aikatau mai karɓar aiki da maras karɓar aiki
learningObjectives: Fahimtar ma'anar aikatau a nahawun Hausa
Bambanta tsakanin aikatau mai wucewa (transitive) da maras wucewa (intransitive)
Gina jimloli masu ɗauke da nau'o'in aikatau daban-daban

topics.topic: Wakilin Suna: Rabe-raben wakilin suna (na kanka, na nuni, na tambaya)
learningObjectives: Bada ma'anar wakilin suna da muhimmancinsa wajen magana
Gane wakilin sunan mutum (ni, kai, ke, shi, ita, mu, ku, su)
Amfani da wakilin suna don kauce wa maimaita suna a jimloli

topics.topic: Al'adun Haihuwa da Rainon Jariri a Ƙasar Hausa
learningObjectives: Bayyana yadda ake kula da mai ciki da rainon sabon jariri a al'ada
Gane al'adun wanka, duba, da abincin mai jego
Bayyana alakar da ke tsakanin tarbiyyar farko da zaman lafiyar al'umma

topics.topic: Adabin Rubuce: Littafin wasan kwaikwayo da jigon labari
learningObjectives: Karatun zaɓaɓɓen littafin wasan kwaikwayo na Hausa da NERDC ta amince da shi
Gano jigon labari, rikici, da yadda aka warware shi
Tattauna halayen 'yan wasan da suka fi shahara

topics.topic: Rubutun Wasika: Wasikar sada zumunci ga 'yan'uwa da abokan arziki
learningObjectives: Koya sassan wasikar zumunci (adireshi, kwanan wata, gaisuwa, bayani, bankwana)
Amfani da salon magana mai nuna ƙauna da girmamawa
Rubuta cikakkiyar wasika zuwa ga aboki game da hutu

topics.topic: Gidajen Gargajiya da Tsarin Unguwanni a Ƙasar Hausa
learningObjectives: Bayyana tsarin ginin gida na gargajiya (zaure, tsakar gida, shinge)
Gane matsayin mai gida, uwar gida, da sauran 'yan dangi
Bayyana tsarin sarautar unguwa karkashin Mai Unguwa da Dagaci

topics.topic: Gwajin Tsakiyar Zango da Tantance Ayyukan Dalubai
learningObjectives: Auna fahimtar ɗalibai a fannin aikatau da wakilin suna
Duba wasiƙun da ɗalibai suka rubuta don gyara kuskure
Bada ƙarin haske a wuraren da ba a gane ba sosai

topics.topic: Siffa da Rabe-rabenta a Harshen Hausa
learningObjectives: Bayyana ma'anar siffa a matsayin mai ƙara bayani kan suna
Gane siffofin launi, girma, da ɗabi'a (fari, babba, mai kirki)
Haɗa suna da siffa cikin jimloli masu ma'ana

topics.topic: Adabin Baka: Habaici, zambo, da kirari a Hausa
learningObjectives: Bambanta tsakanin habaici da zambo a zaman jama'a
Fahimtar amfanin kirari ga mayaka, maharba, da 'yan kokawa
Gane illar zambo da zagi a cikin al'umma

topics.topic: Tsarin Shari'a da Yanke Hukunci a Ƙasar Hausa ta Gargajiya
learningObjectives: Gane matsayin Alkali da Mai Shari'a a al'ummar Hausawa
Bayyana yadda ake shari'a tsakanin masu jayayya a kotu ko fada
Gane muhimmancin gaskiya da adalci wajen tabbatar da zaman lafiya

topics.topic: Ƙa'idojin Rubutu: Ƙarfafa Haruffa da Gajartawa
learningObjectives: Koya yadda ake amfani da babban baƙi wajen rubuta sunayen mutane da garuruwa
Gane yadda ake gajarta kalmomi a rubuce
Tabbatar da ingancin rubutun kalmomin zamani a Hausa

topics.topic: Cikakkiyar Bita don Shirin Jarabawar Ƙarshen Zango
learningObjectives: Sake nazarin dukkan darussan da aka koya tun daga farkon zango
Amsa tambayoyi daban-daban a kan nahawu da adabi
Shirya ɗalibai don samun sakamako mai kyau
Gudanar da jarabawa don auna ilimin ɗalibai a wannan zangon
Tantance makin ɗalibai bisa ka'ida
Shigar da sakamako cikin rajistar makaranta
